posts.author: Ancient_Eagle
posts.body:
(Game Development Project by Ancient Eagle)
Hello everyone! My name is
Ancient Eagle
, and I’m working on a new RPG Maker MV project called
White Bomber: The Showdown
.
The project is inspired by
Mega Man Battle Network
for its futuristic, grid-style world concept. The game combines
UAE cultural elements
with a
sci-fi tournament story
, offering something both unique and familiar for fans of grid battle system.
Spoiler:
Story
The game takes place in a
futuristic Abu Dhabi
, where people use their phones to communicate with
AI partner robots
. Every year, a massive tournament is held, bringing fighters from across the world.
Our story follows
Fahim
, a student, and his AI partner
White Bomber
. Together, they enter the
AI Fighter Network Tournament
with the dream of winning the grand prize of
3 million AED
. Along the way, they face rivals, uncover mysteries, and deal with unexpected romance and rivalries.
Spoiler:
Gameplay
Grid-Based Battle System
– Battles are fought on a
6x3 grid
, where players move White Bomber across panels and use attacks in real time, just like MegaMan Battle Network.
AI Partner System
– Each fighter has a unique robot with strengths, weaknesses, and personalities.
Chip/Card Mechanics
– Use battle chips to perform special attacks and strategies.
Exploration
– Explore
city maps
featuring streets, plazas, cafés, repair shops, and hidden alleys with items and NPCs. Also dive into the
cyberworld
, where you can battle viruses, collect new
cards
, and earn
D.CP and HP
(D.CP stands for
Deck Capacity Point
).
Arcade Minigames
– Fun side activities that let players enjoy short challenges and earn rewards
(still under preparation)
.
Spoiler:
Key Features
Around
19 bosses
, including virus AI, rival fighters, and champion opponents.
UAE cultural elements
such as futuristic Abu Dhabi city design, plazas with palm trees, and national landmarks.
Pixel-art graphics
with original assets created in Aseprite.
PET-style menu system
, fully replacing the default RPG Maker menu.
Multi-language support planned
: English, Arabic, Japanese, French, Korean, and Chinese.
Target release:
Q2 2027
(PEGI 12).

posts.author: Ancient_Eagle
posts.body:
For characters, it's still in progress; because I have more than 20's characters, but you can check below.
Spoiler:
Characters (In Progress)
Name: Fahim (MC)
Age: 14
A quiet student who was bullied for not having an AI partner like everyone else. He bought an old smartphone by using his saving money, Fahim finally receives a powerful AI Fighter—
White Bomber
. Together, they start to change his life as Fahim grows braver, saves people from viruses, and prepares to face tough tournament challenges.
Name: White Bomber (MC)
Age: ???
Fahim’s loyal AI Fighter and closest ally. On the grid, he is fast, strategic, and powerful. Off the battlefield, White Bomber brings humor with his dramatic respect toward females, often lightening the mood while still staying brave and protective of Fahim.
Name: Ahmed (Support MC)
Age: 14
Ahmed is Fahim’s loyal best friend, full of energy and naturally funny without trying. He always lightens the mood with his playful personality and never lets Fahim feel alone. Competitive by nature, he often argues with Fatima about whose AI is stronger, turning even serious moments into friendly rivalries. His humor and confidence make him the perfect partner outside the battlefield.

posts.author: Ancient_Eagle
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
Sorry for not posting, I was making some upgrades that I made some upgrades battle system, what I did part is:
- I add effective state (like increasing defense, some elements I used for armor LV1 and 2 and 3, freezing, burning and paralyze)
- Some chips I already modify and add 1 chip same as Vulcan
- Add escape battle, if you allowed to escape the battle, it will escape as default like mv, otherwise you will fight without chip (same behavior of Mega Man Battle Network)
- Add gamepad and keyboard configure (you can adjust keyboard buttons and gamepad)
- Add Shield chip
- Modify the menus and add helper button to understand
- Add tutorial cutscene.
The parts are under progress:
- Charge Shot (Add a new normal attack)
- Lights (for tilesets, events and stories)
- Minigames (After complete demo)
- Summon (Same as Mega Man Battle Network and Final Fantasy)
- Create a cutscenes in the battle.
Also, good news, I am about to start making story mode, so I will prepare demo version and upgrade the battle system
